newsitem.title: USA: Snyder Comm completes American List merger.
newsitem.headline: Snyder Comm completes American List merger.

text.p: Snyder Communications Inc said Friday it has completed its acquisition of American List Corp.

In the transaction accounted for as a pooling of interest, Snyder said it acquired American List for about 5.1 million shares of its common stock. The merger is expected to add to its 1997 and 1998 earanings per share, it said.
Snyder said it has entered into employment agreements with key American List executives, including founder and president Martin Lerner.
It said trading of American List will cease at the close of business on July 11.

American List is a Mineola, N.Y.-based company that maintains and markets databases on students and young adults. It holds information on about 30 million individuals and rents lists to organizations interested in offering their services by direct marketing.
Snyder Chairman and Chief Executive Officere Daniel Snyder said the combination of Snyder and American List creates a marketing organization with a database exceeding 50 million consumers.
